scripts.build: bun build src/client/login.ts src/client/admin.ts src/client/vote.ts --outdir public/assets --target browser --minify
scripts.dev: bun run build && bunx wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply vote-counter --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply vote-counter --remote
